# TabPanel { #anylumino.TabPanel }

```python
TabPanel(
    widgets=None,
    *,
    titles=None,
    keys=None,
    selected_index=0,
    tab_placement='top',
    tabs_movable=False,
    width='100%',
    height=420,
    resizable=True,
    fit_content=False,
)
```

Lumino tab container for composing child widgets.

Children can be passed as a list or as a keyed mapping. Mapping keys become
stable child identifiers and default tab titles. Use ``select_key`` or
``selected_index`` to choose the active tab.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                                       | Description                                                                                                                                       | Default   |
|----------------|--------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| widgets        | iterable or mapping                        | Child anywidget-compatible widgets or owner objects exposing a ``widget`` attribute. When a mapping is passed, its keys become stable child keys. | `None`    |
| titles         | iterable or mapping                        | Tab titles. A mapping is resolved by child key. When ``widgets`` is a mapping and titles are omitted, keys are used as titles.                    | `None`    |
| keys           | iterable of str                            | Stable child keys for iterable ``widgets``. Do not pass this when ``widgets`` is a mapping.                                                       | `None`    |
| selected_index | int                                        | Initially selected tab index.                                                                                                                     | `0`       |
| tab_placement  | (\'top\', \'bottom\', \'left\', \'right\') | Where Lumino should place the tab bar.                                                                                                            | `"top"`   |
| tabs_movable   | bool                                       | Whether tabs can be reordered in the frontend.                                                                                                    | `False`   |
| width          | int, float, str, or None                   | Widget width. Numbers above 1 are pixels, numbers between 0 and 1 are percentages, and strings are passed through as CSS sizes.                   | `'100%'`  |
| height         | int, float, str, or None                   | Widget height. Numbers above 1 are pixels, numbers between 0 and 1 are percentages, and strings are passed through as CSS sizes.                  | `420`     |
| resizable      | bool                                       | Whether the panel receives a notebook-friendly resize handle.                                                                                     | `True`    |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [selected_index](#anylumino.TabPanel.selected_index) | An int trait. |
